meta.name: mcp-deepwiki
meta.description: Skills for accessing and searching docs in DeepWiki/GitHub’s public code repositories can help users understand open-source project source codes, and users can also ask questions directly about the code docs.

copy.tagline: 搜索并理解开源项目源码文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速查阅开源项目文档并提问
copy.tagline_en: Search and understand open-source project source docs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly browse open-source project docs and ask questions

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以访问 DeepWiki 和 GitHub 上公开代码仓库的文档，并回答关于这些仓库源码的问题。
howto.when: 当用户要求查看某个 GitHub 仓库的文档结构、内容，或询问关于该仓库的具体问题时触发。

say.text: 查看 facebook/react 的文档结构
读取 facebook/react 的文档内容
问 facebook/react 的组件生命周期问题

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can access documentation from DeepWiki and GitHub public repositories, and answer questions about the source code of those repositories.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to view the documentation structure or contents of a GitHub repository, or asks a specific question about a repository.

say_en.text: Show the wiki structure of facebook/react
say_en.note: Claude will call read_wiki_structure to get the list of documentation topics.

say_en.text: Read the wiki contents of facebook/react
say_en.note: Claude will call read_wiki_contents to retrieve the documentation content.

say_en.text: Ask about component lifecycle in facebook/react
say_en.note: Claude will call ask_question and return an AI-generated answer.
